subject: Kickoff: latent subgroup shift adaptation for platform models
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the latent-shift-adaptation track. The recurring incident pattern on platform models: an unobserved subgroup's prevalence shifts between training and deployment and accuracy quietly craters for that slice, with nothing in the observed features to alert on. The AISTATS work we open-sourced tackles exactly this — adapting to latent subgroup shifts using concept and proxy variables, with both a discrete eigendecomposition approach and continuous spectral / WAE variants.

Milestones (Mar 30 - Jun 29):
- Apr 24: replicate the synthetic-data experiments (Tables 1 and 2 from the released notebooks)
- May 29: apply to one historical platform incident where we have the post-hoc subgroup labels — can the method see the shift we missed?
- Jun 24: readout with a Q3 productionization recommendation

Santiago — staffing/compute please, and start the Q3 budget conversation early; if May works out, the validation runs get expensive.

Dmitri
